text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're amazing! You got so many!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You won some for me, too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you nabbed this many...
Wow.
Getting some for my sisters
would've been more
than enough...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoops, did I say that out loud?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. To tell you the truth, I'm really
happy
right now. Thanks so much!
